The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Background and Canadian Affection
podcast.body: BJ Snowden is a black woman originally from Massachusetts, but she harbors a strong affection for Canada. This connection stems from her grandmother being from Canada, and she enjoys visiting the country. "She's a block woman, originally from Massachusetts, but has a real thing for Canada."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Canadian-Themed Songs
podcast.body: Her most recognized songs are those about Canada, as she has written many tunes about the country and all its provinces. "Her greatest tips, if you want to call it that, all involved songs about Canada. She's written many songs about the country and all the provinces."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Comparisons
podcast.body: She has been compared to Yoko Ono, who is sometimes considered the "grandam of all female outsider musicians." "and she's been compared to people like Yoko Ono, who may be the grandum of all female outsider musicians."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Labeling as Outsider Musician
podcast.body: BJ Snowden was not enthusiastic about being labeled an outsider musician, though she expressed melancholy about the designation. "She wasn't crazy about being labeled an outsider musician, but she's melancholy about that."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Musical Education and Teaching
podcast.body: Snowden is a graduate of the Berkeley College of Music and worked as a music teacher for a period. "BJ is a graduate from the Berkeley College of Music. She was a music teacher for a while"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Notable Fan and Producer
podcast.body: Fred Schneider of The B-52s is one of her biggest fans. He produced a couple of Christmas songs for her. "But one of her biggest fans is Fred Schneider of the B-52s. He produced a couple of Christmas songs for her."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Prominent Figure in Outsider Music
podcast.body: She is considered a significant figure in the outsider music world, having been featured by the BBC, on MTV a couple of times, and on Jimmy Kimmel. "She is a giant of the outside music world. The BBC did a story on her. She's been on MTV a couple of times. There was a Jimmy Kimmel appearance."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
